glosses: to take to, to take a liking to, to take a shine to, to come to like (to develop a fondness for something; to become infatuated with something)
to like (to show support for, approval of, or enjoyment of, something posted on the Internet by marking it with a vote)
to get to like oneself (to accept and like one's own appearance and personality)
to get to like each other (to accept and like each other's appearance and personality)
